title: Japan PM Takaichi Skips Visit To Disputed Shrine On World War II Anniversary
summary_full: The Yasukuni Shrine, which commemorates over 2.4 million people who died in wars, became controversial after enshrining 14 convicted World War II Japanese war criminals.
